title: UAAP: Adamson women boost Final 4 bid with rout of UE
summary: Adamson University fueled its bid for a Final 4 spot by beating the University of the East, 94-77, in the UAAP Season 89 women's basketball tournament on Saturday at the Araneta Coliseum.
